worldcombat.skill.sludge.summary: The user scoops up a wet clump of sludge and hurls it at the foe on a low arc: cheap, quick and PP-rich; a hit may poison the target while the clump clings and drips. Cling style is stickier and more poisonous at the cost of damage and speed.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.0: Chip a distant foe and keep it poisoned
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.1: Always have a cheap shot ready
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.2: Make the foe step out of the arc
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.0: The clump smears for about %1$s damage. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.1: It is thrown up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, and the arc shows where it will land.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.2: After a hit that deals damage, the target has a %1$s poison chance; the poison drains health over time and lasts %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.cling.on: Cling style on: ×1.2 glob size, ×1.3 poison chance and longer poison, at ×0.9 damage, a slower throw and one extra beat of wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.cling.off: Cling style off (Quick throw): ×1.1 damage, a faster throw and a quicker recovery, but a smaller chance to stick.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.growth.0: At level %1$s the wet clump rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.growth.1: At level %1$s the wet clump rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.clin: On: a bigger glob (×1.2 size), ×1.3 poison chance and longer poison, at ×0.9 damage, a slower throw and one extra beat of wind-up, for grinding a foe down. Off (Quick throw): a faster, heavier throw (×1.1 damage) with less chance to stick.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.m: Only foes within this distance become throwing candidates; the shared approach logic then walks the companion into throw range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.s: On, an already poisoned foe is not a candidate: another clump only refreshes the poison, so another target is better. Off throws at poisoned foes too.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.l: On, the companion may leave its post to throw at a target; off restricts it to throws it can make from where it stands.
